title: Diacritic normalization — Tier 1 (10 surnames)
description: Audit P1 item 7, generated by tools/generate_diacritic_manifest.py from the Tier 1 map in docs/diacritic-normalization-map.md. Word-boundary respelling of eponym surnames to the person's orthography across the naming columns; no alias additions, no structural changes.

fields.historical_notes: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 Nc6 - the Chigorin Defence. Named after Mikhail Chigorin, its leading 19th-century practitioner. Attribution applies to this QGD head only; keep distinct from the Ruy López Chigorin (C.RyL.Cha) and the many other 'Chigorin'-labelled lines.
